_comment: Item definitions (GDD 5.5, systems.md 4.3). IDs are permanent once live. reference_value is the starting price R in gold; the market drifts it over time. Tiers: 1 = self-sufficient, 2 = needs another profession.

items.name: Copper Ore
items.description: Soft reddish ore from the guild mine in the cliffs.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description: Dense grey ore. Won't smelt clean without flux.

items.name: Brass Fittings
items.description: Clasps, rivets and hinges. Every ship and workshop in the harbor needs them.

items.name: Copper Lantern
items.description: A sturdy lantern for Portovela's dark alleys and night boats.

items.name: Iron Ingot
items.description: Clean iron, smelted with alchemical flux.

items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: A Regatta-grade blade with a leather grip, favoured by ships' guards.

items.name: Coal
items.description: Black seams from deep in the cliff mine. Every forge in the Arsenale burns it.

items.name: Silver Ore
items.description: A bright vein the mine reaches only at its deepest gallery.

items.name: Copper Kettle
items.description: A riveted kettle for every hearth. Alchemists use them as boiling pots.

items.name: Pig Iron
items.description: Rough iron poured into sand moulds, waiting to be worked.

items.name: Horseshoes
items.description: A set of four, for the carters who haul goods up from the quay.

items.name: Iron Lockbox
items.description: A merchant's strongbox with a brass lock. Every counting house wants two.

items.name: Gears
items.description: Toothed wheels cut by hand: the heart of every water wheel and clock.

items.name: Pump Valve
items.description: Keeps the bilges dry. Ships in the harbor buy them by the crate.

items.name: Regatta Blade
items.description: A sprung duelling blade with a geared guard, made for the Regatta champions.

items.name: Pressure Gauge
items.description: A brass dial that tells a still or a boiler when to stop.

items.name: Steel Bar
items.description: Iron folded and fired until it rings. The finest metal in Portovela.

items.name: Silver Filigree
items.description: Silver drawn into lace-fine wire, for jewels, flasks and the Doge's seals.

items.name: Clockwork Mechanism
items.description: A spring-wound movement that turns on its own for a whole day.

items.name: Trip Hammer
items.description: A water-driven hammer that beats iron while the smith sleeps.

items.name: Sunleaf
items.description: A bright herb from the cliff terraces, with gentle healing properties.

items.name: Ember Moss
items.description: Warm to the touch. Volatile when boiled.

items.name: Healing Draught
items.description: The city's staple remedy. Always in demand.

items.name: Smelting Flux
items.description: Draws impurities out of molten iron.

items.name: Tanning Solution
items.description: Cures thick hides into workable leather.

items.name: Lemon Tonic
items.description: A fizzing lemon restorative sold in brass-capped vials. Sailors swear by it.

items.name: Frostcap
items.description: A pale mushroom grown in the cold cellar beneath the herb garden.

items.name: Starbloom
items.description: A night flower that opens once a week. Its petals glow faintly.

items.name: Lamp Oil
items.description: Pressed sunleaf oil. Burns clean and bright in every harbor lantern.

items.name: Strong Healing Draught
items.description: Twice distilled, with a warming kick of ember moss.

items.name: Dye Set
items.description: Saffron, madder and woad in stoppered pots, for cloth and leather.

items.name: Blasting Powder
items.description: Quarrymen and fireworks makers both swear by it. Keep it dry.

items.name: Machine Oil
items.description: A thick oil that never freezes. Water wheels and gears run quiet on it.

items.name: Frost Draught
items.description: Cools a fever in minutes. Sailors bound for the south carry a flask.

items.name: Preserving Brine
items.description: Keeps fish and meat good for a month at sea. Sold by the kettle.

items.name: Etching Acid
items.description: Bites patterns into steel and silver. Handled with leather-gripped tongs.

items.name: Volatile Spirit
items.description: A spirit so light it burns blue. Drives the hottest forges.

items.name: Philosopher's Salt
items.description: Glittering crystals the guild guards closely. The base of the great elixirs.

items.name: Elixir of Vigor
items.description: A silver-caged flask said to give a day of strength. The Doge keeps one by his bed.

items.name: Aether Tonic
items.description: A sealed, geared bottle that hums. Nobody agrees what it does, and everybody wants one.

items.name: Raw Hide
items.description: Common hide from the trappers' short runs.

items.name: Thick Hide
items.description: Heavy hide. Needs tanning solution to cure.

items.name: Leather Grip
items.description: Wrapped grips for blades and tools.

items.name: Hide Satchel
items.description: A simple bag every apprentice carries.

items.name: Cured Leather
items.description: Supple, tough leather ready for armour.

items.name: Rugged Jerkin
items.description: Brass-buckled leather armour favoured by sailors and ships' guards.

items.name: Eelskin
items.description: Slick, tough skins from the lagoon eel traps. Water slides right off.

items.name: Fine Fur
items.description: Soft winter pelts brought down from the mountain trappers.

items.name: Work Gloves
items.description: Stiff gloves for the dockhands, the masons and the forge.

items.name: Hide Cord
items.description: Strong braided cord for stitching and lacing heavy leather.

items.name: Trail Boots
items.description: Laced boots for the mountain road. Good for a thousand miles.

items.name: Dyed Satchel
items.description: A satchel in the Regatta's colours. Every clerk in the Palazzo carries one.

items.name: Drive Belt
items.description: A long loop of stitched leather that carries a water wheel's power to the work.

items.name: Eelskin Coat
items.description: Rain runs off it like water off an eel. The harbor pilots all wear one.

items.name: Explorer's Pack
items.description: A waterproofed pack with a dozen pockets, for voyages past the charts.

items.name: Saddle
items.description: A tooled saddle for the Duke's couriers.

items.name: Pressure Gasket
items.description: An oiled eelskin seal that holds against steam, water and spirit.

items.name: Fur-lined Cloak
items.description: A winter cloak fit for a senator. Warm enough for the Alps.

items.name: Ornithopter Harness
items.description: A geared harness for a flying machine, after the old master's drawings. Nobody has flown it yet.

items.name: Diving Suit
items.description: A sealed eelskin suit with a steel helmet and a diver's lamp, for salvage in the lagoon.
